events.name: The Yoddha Race Mumbai
events.registration_notes: Doubles and Mixed Doubles available; Male and Female Open paused at time of check. Ticket transfer allowed up to 7 days before for Rs 300 + GST; not transferable across category or city.
events.summary: A regional round of The Yoddha Race, an Indian fitness race by Spectacom Global (organisers of Devils Circuit) combining about 5 km of running with 7 strength and conditioning zones. Season 3 has six regionals feeding a national finale with a Rs 30 lakh prize pool; there is no regional prize money this season. Female Open and Male/Female Doubles race on Saturday 21 Nov; Male Open and Mixed Doubles on Sunday 22 Nov.

categories.name: Male Open
categories.notes: Sled push 150 kg, sled pull 100 kg, 2 x 24 kg kettlebells, 60 cm box, 20 kg lunge, 75 wall balls at 6 kg to 9 ft. 7 x 700 m run, each followed by a zone: row 1000 m, sled push 50 m, sled pull 50 m, kettlebell carry 200 m, 30 box jumps, lunge walk 100 m, wall balls.

categories.name: Female Open
categories.notes: Sled push 100 kg, sled pull 70 kg, 2 x 16 kg kettlebells, 50 cm box, 10 kg lunge, 50 wall balls at 4 kg to 8 ft.

categories.name: Male Doubles
categories.notes: Price per team of 2; Male Open weights.

categories.name: Female Doubles
categories.notes: Price per team of 2; Female Open weights.

categories.name: Mixed Doubles
categories.notes: Price per team of 2; both partners use Male Open weights.

course.description: Continuous loop: a 700 m run followed by one workout zone, repeated 7 times (about 5 km of running in total). Venue not yet announced; coordinates are a city-centre placeholder.

highlights: About 5 km running plus 7 workout zones
Dynamic national leaderboard feeding a Rs 30 lakh finale
Masters (40+) recognition at regional level this season
Finisher medal only for times under 90 minutes
tips: Reporting time is emailed 10-14 days before; waves are allotted, not chosen
Headphones, phones and lifting belts or straps are not allowed on course
Wrong lap counts add 5 minutes per error; missing a run or zone is a DQ
Up to 2 spectators per athlete free; register them via the link sent before race day

events.name: IndusInd Bank HYROX Gujarat
events.registration_notes: Prices as listed on the official ticket shop, per athlete. Flex add-on allows 100% refund up to 31 days and 50% up to 7 days before. Spectator ticket Rs 770; under-12 and 65+ spectators free.
events.summary: HYROX's first race in Gujarat, held over three days in Gandhinagar after sell-out events in Delhi and Mumbai. HYROX is a standardised indoor fitness race of 8 km running and 8 functional stations, with the same format worldwide. Results count towards age-group World Championship qualification in some divisions.

categories.name: HYROX Open (Men / Women)
categories.notes: Men race Thu 26 or Fri 27 Nov; Women Thu 26 or Sat 28 Nov. 8 x 1 km run, each followed by a station: SkiErg 1000 m, sled push 50 m, sled pull 50 m, burpee broad jumps 80 m, row 1000 m, farmers carry 200 m, sandbag lunges 100 m, 100 wall balls.

categories.name: HYROX Pro (Men / Women)
categories.notes: Fri 27 Nov. Heavier weights (e.g. men's sled push 202 kg vs 152 kg Open, wall ball 9 kg vs 6 kg).

categories.name: HYROX Doubles (Men / Women / Mixed)
categories.notes: Price per athlete; both partners buy a ticket. Partners run together and split station work. Thu to Sat depending on category.

categories.name: HYROX Pro Doubles (Men / Women)
categories.notes: Price per athlete. Sat 28 Nov.

categories.name: HYROX Relay (Men / Women / Mixed, team of 4)
categories.notes: Price per team member. Each member runs 2 x 1 km and does 2 stations. Sat 28 Nov.

categories.name: HYROX Adaptive (Men / Women)
categories.notes: Men Fri 27 Nov, Women Sat 28 Nov.

course.description: Indoor race in an exhibition centre: 8 laps of 1 km running, each followed by one of 8 workout stations in a fixed order. Venue coordinates approximate.

highlights: First HYROX race in Gujarat
Standard global format: 8 km running plus 8 stations
Age-group awards and World Championship qualification slots in some age groups
Sportograf race photos available
tips: Bring physical photo ID; check-in is only on your race day and opens 90 minutes before your division's first wave
Individual start times are published about 3 days before; start time changes are not allowed
Each athlete must personalise the ticket with their own unique email or it cannot be used
Buy the Flex add-on if your plans may change; standard tickets are non-refundable
